messages.content: In a city, there are 200 pounds of carrots and 50 pounds of potatoes. These vegetables are to be distributed to 40 restaurants. Each restaurant is to receive 2 pounds of carrots and no potatoes. How many pounds of carrots will not be used?

content.text:
## Solving the Carrot Distribution Problem

**Given information:**
- Total carrots available: 200 pounds
- Total potatoes available: 50 pounds
- Number of restaurants: 40
- Each restaurant receives: 2 pounds of carrots

**Step 1:** Calculate the total carrots distributed to all restaurants.
$$40 \text{ restaurants} \times 2 \text{ pounds} = 80 \text{ pounds of carrots}$$

**Step 2:** Calculate the unused carrots.
$$200 \text{ pounds} - 80 \text{ pounds} = 120 \text{ pounds}$$

**Answer: 120 pounds of carrots will not be used.**
